messages:
mina: Heads-up — I'm drafting the internal release notes and announcement for release 2.4.0. Deploy planned in the weekly change window Tue 03:30-04:30 UTC. Need agreement on model pinning (v3.0-stable vs v3.1-rc canary) and rollback triggers. @alex @jordan

alex: I vote pin prod -> v3.0-stable, run v3.1-rc as canary only. We saw kernel perf regressions on long sequences in integration tests.

jordan: +1 for pin. Also call out the quantization change in RN — it reduces memory but alters a few edge-case completions. Ops should watch regen rates.

mina: Draft snippet (raw):
```
Release 2.4.0 — internal notes:
- Models: prod pinned to v3.0-stable; v3.1-rc enabled for canaries (10% traffic).
- Inference: int8 quantization enabled for batch pipelines.
- Rollback policy: automatic fallback to v3.0-stable if error rate >= 5% for 5m or p95 latency increases > 25%.
- Tracing: add tag rn/2.4.0 to generated spans for easier postmortem.
```
Thoughts?

sylvia: Minor tweaks: mention tenant-scoped rollout (so enterprise customers can opt-out), and note who to escalate to (ops/@ops-lead). Prefer rollback trigger: sustained 3m p95 increase OR >4% error rate for 5m.

ops-lead: Confirming change window Tue 03:30-04:30 UTC. Ops will be on watch. Proposed rollback triggers: sustained 3m p95 latency up or >4% error rate sustained for 5m. Ops will hold the abort key and run the rollback playbook on command.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy events:
- staging: 2123456900
- canary: 2123457600
- prod: 2123461200
Artifacts: r2.4.0.tar.gz
Config: model.pin="v3.0-stable" (canary uses v3.1-rc)
RollbackHook: enabled

alex: Add a short bullet about logs/tracing: support should grep rn/2.4.0 and escalate to @sylvia or @ops-lead. Also include the canary percentage (10%).

mina: Updated draft with edits: 
```
Release 2.4.0 — internal notes:
- Models: prod pinned to v3.0-stable; v3.1-rc enabled for canaries (10% traffic). Tenants can opt-out of canary via feature flag.
- Inference: int8 quantization enabled for batch pipelines.
- Rollback policy: sustained 3m p95 latency increase OR >4% error rate for 5m -> auto-fallback to v3.0-stable.
- Observability: add tag rn/2.4.0 to spans; support to search logs for rn/2.4.0 and escalate to @sylvia or @ops-lead.
```
Please react :eyes: if this is good to post internally 4 hours before prod.

sylvia: LGTM :thumbsup:

jordan: Looks good.

mina: Will schedule the internal announcement (copy below) 4h before prod deploy and pin the release note in #eng-releases. Thanks everyone.

mina: Internal announce copy (for review):
"Heads-up: Release 2.4.0 will go to prod Tue 03:30-04:30 UTC. Prod will be pinned to v3.0-stable; a v3.1-rc canary (10%) will run first. Quantization changes enabled for batch jobs. Ops will monitor rn/2.4.0 traces and can rollback to v3.0-stable on triggers (sustained 3m p95 increase or >4% error rate for 5m). Support escalation: @sylvia / @ops-lead."

ops-lead: Received. I'll be available during the window and will run the rollback playbook if thresholds are hit.

mina: Great — posting in ~4h unless any last-minute objections.
